text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.*2. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity).*3. English proficiency test certificateFor example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.*4. High school graduate certificateAccording to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.*5. High school academic transcriptAccording to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: academic transcript in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.*6. Bank statementPhotocopy of the bank statement with signature*7. Physical examination record for foreignerPhysical examination record for foreigner*8. The scan copy of passport front page and blank pages.
